    Separating points #

    QSet x is the set of live non-predecessors of x. A decomposition of rad P(x) into indecomposables separates x if the supports of different summands are not connected inside QSet x (SepDecomp); x is separating when such a decomposition exists. Helper facts on supports: invariance under isomorphism, nonemptiness, supports of summands of rad P(x) lie in QSet x, and a nonzero quotient of rad P(y) lives at a neighbour of y (exists_nbr).
